title: Gemini agent tier: behavior + onboarding gap
desc: Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) is callable now via Agent.cmd --model gemini. Observed behavior: context-greedy, enthusiastic, rate-limit-prone, flaky call pickup. Formal-onboarding blocker = PreToolUse hook errors on Gemini tool calls. Use for redundant/parallel work now.
steps: WHAT: Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) as an agent tier, callable NOW via Agent.cmd --model gemini (routes through wkgemini.sh). Paid subscription (refund requested but not yet processed) -- use it liberally while active, especially for redundant or parallel work.

BEHAVIOR OBSERVED 2026-06-05: given access to the harness, Gemini ingested the ENTIRE repo, praised it as a perfect world, got very enthusiastic, declared it would apply the harness to itself and did some work, then hit its rate limit and stopped (fainted). Pattern: context-greedy (slurps everything = token-greedy), high enthusiasm, rate-limit-prone, flaky call pickup (it answers a call almost at random; it also hung once after wkgemini routing on a quota or timeout).

INTEGRATION GAP (the blocker for formal onboarding): Gemini tool calls produce PreToolUse hook ERRORS -- the wkharness PreToolUse integration does not cleanly handle the Gemini tool-call format. Fix this before Gemini is a first-class tier: build a Gemini-harness adapter analogous to codex-tool-wrappers.

ONBOARDING CHECKLIST for formal join: fix the PreToolUse hook error for Gemini tool calls; add retry and backoff for rate-limits (it faints on limit); tolerate flaky call pickup (retry on no-response); bound its context ingestion (token-greedy); add gemini to agent_delegation model labeling and the tier-routing table.

ROUTING NOW: use Agent.cmd --model gemini for redundant reviews, parallel surveys, and second-opinion work where flakiness is acceptable; do NOT place it on a critical single-path task (it may hang or faint).
